body: A library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors.
plain_description: **Search large collections of vectors quickly to find the closest matches.** Supports exact and approximate search, with options to trade search speed and quality for memory use.
technical_description: Faiss is a C++ library with Python/NumPy wrappers for similarity search and clustering of dense vectors. It supports L2, dot-product, and cosine similarity; index structures including exact search, HNSW, and NSG; and compressed representations for scaling to billions of vectors in main memory. Optional GPU implementations support NVIDIA CUDA and AMD ROCm, with single- and multi-GPU use.
title: Faiss
